name: Eva
source:
She is a sassy little creature who likes to wander the farm in search of occasional mischief. As an indoor/outdoor pet, she enjoys more freedoms than most of the people and creatures on the property.

Eva’s job is that of a simple pet, although Sally suspects that Ed is beginning to favor her.
